description: Hi! I’m joining NASA Space Apps 2026 with a project called ORBITALIS under the challenge “Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions.” Our team, RITIM, is interested in building a smart system that uses physiological data to help monitor astronaut health. I’m looking for teammates interested in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, biology, human health, space science, and UI/UX. If you want to work on something meaningful and exciting, feel free to join!
